title: Gracie Abrams's fans were outraged by the singer's very expensive mercantile
text:
By Emily Lefroy for Dailymail.com
Published: 19:32 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 19:50 GMT, February 13, 2025
It is a hard love for Gracie Abrams fans, who are hitting the artist for their expensive merchandising.
The 25 -year -old singer, who will be honored at the Billboard Women in Music event in March, has a merchandise line available on his website that some have declared “crazy.”
“We need to talk about how Merch of crazy artists is receiving,” said Tiktok Brandon user in a recent clip.
Then he showed a vinyl box available on the Gracie website, which seems to be a blue plastic milk box with Gracie Abrams written in a white italic script on the side.
‘Gracie, what is this? He questioned, pointing to the box. “This is literally just a milk box with Gracie Abrams written in it.”
Brandon said that he understands that wanting to have a merchandise of vinyl attached to an artist, but says: “When (the products) are done at a low price, what is the point.”
And others rushed to agree.
‘Why is the merchandising of Gracie Abrams so expensive, not the shirts but the hoodie? Like $ 99 for a hoodie is crazy! A fan was stripped.

Another said that there were different prices depending on which country the online store was.
‘The way he would save money buying at the Gracie Abrams store in the United Kingdom instead of the German store. This makes no sense. I don’t understand who chooses merchandise prices, this is ridiculous, ” wrote a horrified client.
“I want Gracie Abrams Merch to be so bad why everything is so expensive,” another person complained.
Fans responded to publications on social networks that share their thoughts about merchandise.
“I saw this and shouted,” a user wrote.
‘The box is really great because regular milk boxes are no longer fit in vinyl because they were still stolen in the past. So, one that is good for them is a great idea, I would buy it, ‘another pointed out.
‘I love the interesting merchandising, but why is it so expensive girl?’ another complained.
“I like creativity, but prices are too crazy,” said someone else.
‘It’s so out of contact, it’s crazy. The nepotism is disconcerting, ‘he hit another user.

Last year, Gracie left fans with a sour taste in the mouth with the prices of “unjustifiable” tickets for the second American stage of their tour.
It was announced earlier this week that the 25 -year singer of people close to you would make more dates throughout the country next summer as part of it The Secret of Us Deluxe Tour.
Shortly after Gracie announced their shows, however, fans discovered in the presale that two VIP tickets at Madison Square Garden would leave them back with $ 648.40.
The singer’s fans, who is the daughter of the filmmaker JJ Abrams and Katie McGrath, were furious for the ‘absurd’ ticket prices and expressed their outrage on social networks.
